contract: The lab hashes json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) plus a final newline, encoded as UTF-8 (conformance/lab/canonical.py). This is NOT RFC 8785: keys sort by code point, non-ASCII is literal, numbers use Python's repr. A verifier of a lab package digest must reproduce these bytes exactly. Input is {text}, a JSON document in its own key order; parse it and canonicalize the value. The result is {canonical_utf8, sha256}.
